hypothesis: Growth in reported aggregate futures-chain open interest reflects expanding risk demand and predicts subsequent asset direction.
relationship: New all-chain quarterly-growth monthly target; legacy V7/V8 already contained active-contract 1/5-session OI features, so this is not a claim that OI itself was never used. Not V16 participant crowding, V68 option volume, or a retuned old model.

source.catalog_role: V64 recent observations, all reported BR/MIX/RI/SI contracts, not active contract only
source.availability: trade date plus one calendar day 00:00 Moscow, current-vintage conservative proxy; source_date strictly before decision_date
source.aggregation: sum all reported contracts per date/asset only when every reported OI is finite/nonnegative; any NULL masks entire total; no dropped NULL contracts or zero imputation
source.completeness_limit: complete reported rows does not prove that every listed contract was present; market-wide inventory and original publication vintages are unproved

signal.control: constant long with identical monthly feature-availability mask; not eligible for post-hoc promotion
signal.growth_eligibility: both endpoint totals positive and complete; at least 63 prior factual asset dates; no date gap greater than 7 days anywhere in the interval
signal.schedule: first factual decision session of each calendar month; use latest strictly prior EOD snapshot, freeze signal until next monthly decision
signal.invalid_monthly_snapshot: flat for month, supersedes previous month; never fall back to older valid report
signal.execution: daily fixed target weights and causal rolls at next factual active-contract open; monthly direction, not monthly-only integer sizing

execution.terminal: flat at last factual effective date before 2026

screen_gates.coverage_denominator: all monthly asset decisions including initial warmup
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE only, not a replacement of the 20-50 percent goal

validation.scheme: already-open 2018-2025 development history, eight yearly reports and both costs; no fitting or outcome-selected split

limitations: Reported futures-chain OI is not investor net buying: every outstanding contract has both counterparties.
Quarterly count growth is a lab hypothesis, not an exact replication of the Hong-Yogo commodity study or proof for MOEX.
Source membership, contract lifecycle and missingness can affect aggregate OI; no full-market completeness claim.
Historical availability, daily opens, fees and margin are research proxies, not original vintages, executable BBO or broker fills.
Same development history has been opened repeatedly; a positive result would still need robustness and new prospective evidence.
forbidden_followups: change signs, horizon, schedule, assets, missing policy, controls or leverage after outcomes
promote control or a selected good year
claim verified 20-50 percent return from Stage1
read protected 2026 or restart old paper bootstrap
